summary: Master advanced FP&A techniques, driver-based modeling, and predictive analytics. Elevate your finance career with our expert-led 5-day training program.
lede: Financial planning and analysis training helps finance professionals turn operating assumptions into budgets, forecasts, and decision-ready performance insight. It is designed for people working with budgets, management accounts, forecasts, or business performance data who need to support resource decisions across functions. Participants practise integrated three-statement modelling, scenario planning, and variance analysis to explain results and inform management actions.
audienceIntro: This advanced FP&A course suits finance professionals who already work with budgets, management accounts, forecasts, or business performance data and need to strengthen decision support across functions.
audience: Business Unit Director using FP&A dashboards
modules: FP&A Operating Model and Planning Context
prerequisites: Advanced level. You should have practical experience with budgeting, management reporting, forecasting, or financial analysis, plus working knowledge of income statements, balance sheets, cash-flow statements, and spreadsheet modelling. No programming is required. You will use spreadsheet-based exercises and dashboard design concepts rather than deploy production software or machine-learning models.
